text: ① 全天 A股休市（10月1-7日），港股休市、陆港通关闭； ② 07:50 日本央行发布9月货币政策会议的摘要； ③ 08:00 韩国9月出口； ④ 08:30 日本9月制造业PMI终值，韩国9月制造业PMI，越南9月制造业PMI； ⑤ 09:30 澳洲联储发布金融稳定性报告； ⑥ 10:00 华为将发布Mate90系列； ⑦ 13:00 印度9月制造业PMI终值； ⑧ 14:30 瑞士9月CPI； ⑨ 15:55 德国9月制造业PMI终值； ⑩ 16:00 欧元区9月制造业PMI终值，英国央行行长贝利讲话； ⑪ 16:20 欧洲央行执委Cipollo
text_en: ① A-shares closed all day (October 1-7), Hong Kong stocks closed, Stock Connect shut; ② 07:50 Bank of Japan releases summary of opinions from its September monetary policy meeting; ③ 08:00 South Korea September exports; ④ 08:30 Japan September final manufacturing PMI, South Korea September manufacturing PMI, Vietnam September manufacturing PMI; ⑤ 09:30 Reserve Bank of Australia releases financial stability report; ⑥ 10:00 Huawei to launch Mate90 series; ⑦ 13:00 India September final manufacturing PMI; ⑧ 14:30 Switzerland September CPI; ⑨ 15:55 Germany September final manufacturing PMI; ⑩ 16:00 Eurozone September final manufacturing PMI, Bank of England Governor Bailey speaks; ⑪ 16:20 ECB Executive Board member Cipollone
